He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Valparaiso Beacons men's basketball|Valparaiso Crusaders]] and the [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul Blue Demons]]. ==High school career== Freeman-Liberty began playing high school basketball for [[Seton Academy (South Holland, Illinois)|Seton Academy]] in [[South Holland, Illinois]]. After the school closed, he transferred to [[Whitney M. Young Magnet High School]] in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]].{{cite web|first=Evan F.|last=Moore|title=Javon Freeman, Xavier Castaneda are built to take Whitney Young back to state tournament|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/169722/2017/11/29/javon-freeman-xavier-castaneda-are-built-to-take-whitney-young-back-to-state-tournament/|work=[[The Athletic]]|date=November 29, 2017|access-date=November 23, 2021}} As a junior, Freeman-Liberty averaged 13.6 points, 5.2 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game, helping his team win the Class 4A state title.{{cite web|first=Michael|last=Osipoff|title=Whitney Young guard Javon Freeman-Liberty commits to Valparaiso|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/post-tribune/sports/ct-ptb-mens-basketball-valparaiso-javon-freeman-liberty-st-0904-20170903-story.html|work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=September 3, 2017|access-date=November 23, 2021}} In his senior season, he averaged about 20 points and six rebounds per game, leading Whitney Young back to the state title game.{{cite web|first=Maddi|last=Smith|title=DePaul basketball: Homecoming for Javon Freeman-Liberty|url=https://deceptivespeed.com/depaul-basketball-homecoming-for-javon-freeman-liberty/|work=Deceptive Speed College Football|date=January 30, 2021|access-date=November 23, 2021|archive-date=February 21, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210221072141/https://deceptivespeed.com/depaul-basketball-homecoming-for-javon-freeman-liberty/|url-status=dead}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Valparaiso Beacons men's basketball|Valparaiso]] over offers from [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU]] and [[Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball|Saint Louis]], among others. ==College career== As a freshman at Valparaiso, Freeman-Liberty averaged 11 points and 4.3 rebounds per game, earning [[Missouri Valley Conference]] (MVC) All-Defensive and All-Freshman honors.{{cite web|first=Paul|last=Oren|title=After initially expressing plans to transfer, Freeman-Liberty returning to Valparaiso|url=https://www.nwitimes.com/sports/college/valparaiso-university/after-initially-expressing-plans-to-transfer-freeman-liberty-returning-to-valparaiso/article_42390d15-3203-513b-8374-7cda93ef1837.html|work=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]]|date=May 3, 2019|access-date=November 23, 2021}} On November 25, 2019, he posted a sophomore season-high 32 points, nine rebounds, four assists and four steals in an 81–77 overtime loss to [[2019–20 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]].{{cite web|first=Michael|last=Osipoff|title=Men's basketball notes: Javon Freeman-Liberty nearly carries Valparaiso to upset of Cincinnati|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/post-tribune/sports/ct-ptb-spt-mens-basketball-valparaiso-st-112619-20191126-pkcoyzmrezgqfl4hbvx4zwt7yq-story.html|work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=November 25, 2019|access-date=November 23, 2021}} As a sophomore, Freeman-Liberty averaged 19 points, 6.1 rebounds, 3.2 assists and 2.2 steals per game, setting a program single-season record with 74 steals. He was selected to the All-MVC First Team, All-Defensive Team and Most-Improved Team.{{cite web|title=Javon Freeman-Liberty Granted Immediate Eligibility|url=https://depaulbluedemons.com/news/2020/11/25/mens-basketball-javon-freeman-liberty-granted-immediate-eligibility.aspx|work=DePaul University Athletics|date=November 25, 2020|access-date=November 23, 2021}} Freeman-Liberty declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] before withdrawing and transferring to [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]].{{cite web|first=Lawrence|last=Kreymer|title=DePaul lands transfer Javon Freeman-Liberty|url=https://depauliaonline.com/48198/sports/depaul-lands-transfer-javon-freeman-liberty/|work=[[The DePaulia]]|date=May 1, 2020|access-date=November 23, 2021}} He was granted immediate eligibility.{{cite web|first=Shannon|last=Ryan|title=DePaul's Javon Freeman-Liberty, a Young graduate, is granted immediate eligibility after his transfer from Valparaiso|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/college/ct-depaul-basketball-javon-freeman-liberty-20201126-6qaskagunjf25ao3ezjwhtkeue-story.html|work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=November 25, 2020|access-date=November 23, 2021}} In his junior season, he averaged 14.4 points, 5.3 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game.{{cite web|first=Paul|last=Oren|title=Does Valparaiso have a transfer problem, or is it simply catching up with the times?|url=https://www.nwitimes.com/sports/college/valparaiso-university/does-valparaiso-have-a-transfer-problem-or-is-it-simply-catching-up-with-the-times/article_d9d5137d-d942-5dc8-a7b7-7982d7a6683b.html|work=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]]|date=April 3, 2021|access-date=November 23, 2021}} On November 20, 2021, Freeman-Liberty recorded a career-high 33 points and 11 rebounds in an 84–80 win over [[2021–22 Western Illinois Leathernecks men's basketball team|Western Illinois]].{{cite web|first=Lawrence|last=Kreymer|title='I don't want to lose': Javon Freeman-Liberty proving to be DePaul's leader this season|url=https://depauliaonline.com/55962/sports/i-dont-want-to-lose-javon-freeman-liberty-proving-to-be-depauls-leader-this-season/|work=[[The DePaulia]]|date=November 23, 2021|access-date=November 23, 2021}} On January 13, 2022, he aggravated a groin injury in a 96–92 victory over [[2021–22 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]], forcing him to miss several games.{{cite news|title=Seton Hall's comeback attempt falls short in upset loss to DePaul|url=https://nypost.com/2022/01/13/seton-halls-comeback-falls-short-in-upset-loss-to-depaul/|work=[[New York Post]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=January 13, 2022|access-date=January 26, 2022}} Freeman-Liberty was named to the [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] Second Team.{{cite web|title=Javon Freeman-Liberty Named Second Team All-BIG EAST|url=https://depaulbluedemons.com/news/2022/3/6/mens-basketball-javon-freeman-liberty-named-second-team-all-big-east.aspx|work=[[DePaul Blue Demons]]|date=March 6, 2022|access-date=March 6, 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Windy City Bulls (2022–2023)=== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Freeman-Liberty signed with the [[Chicago Bulls]] on July 7.{{cite web |title=Javon Freeman-Liberty Player Profile, Chicago Bulls - RealGM |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Javon-Freeman-Liberty/Summary/131055 |website=basketball.realgm.com |access-date=1 August 2025 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Hill |first1=Arthur |title=Bulls Sign Javon Freeman-Liberty To Exhibit 10 Deal |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/07/bulls-sign-javon-freeman-liberty-to-exhibit-10-deal.html |access-date=1 August 2025 |work=hoopsrumors.com |date=9 July 2022}} He joined the Bulls for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]. He was waived by Chicago on October 8{{cite news |last1=Adams |first1=Luke |title=Bulls Waive Javon Freeman-Liberty |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/10/bulls-waive-javon-freeman-liberty.html |access-date=1 August 2025 |work=hoopsrumors.com |date=8 October 2022}} and subsequently joined the [[Windy City Bulls]] of the [[NBA G League]] for the [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2022–23 season]].{{cite news|first=Matt|last=Berklan|title=Windy City Bulls Finalize Training Camp Roster|url=https://ontapsportsnet.com/bulls/windy-city-bulls-training-camp-roster-released-chicago-bulls-two-way-players|newspaper=On Tap Sports Net|date=October 23, 2022|access-date=October 23, 2022}} He appeared in 17 regular season games and averaged 18.4 points, 5.8 rebounds, 2.9 assists, 1.4 steals and 30.2 minutes.{{cite web|first=M.|last=Beloso|title=RAPTORS RE-SIGN DOWTIN JR. AND HARPER JR. AND ADD FREEMAN-LIBERTY|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-re-sign-dowtin-jr-and-harper-jr-and-add-freeman-liberty|website=NBA.com|date=July 22, 2023|access-date=July 22, 2023}} Freeman-Liberty re-joined the Chicago Bulls for the [[2023 NBA Summer League]]. ===Toronto Raptors / Raptors 905 (2023–2024)=== On July 22, 2023, Freeman-Liberty signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web|title=RAPTORS RE-SIGN DOWTIN JR. AND HARPER JR. AND ADD FREEMAN-LIBERTY|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-re-sign-dowtin-jr-and-harper-jr-and-add-freeman-liberty|website=NBA.com|date=July 22, 2023|access-date=March 1, 2024}} On March 1, 2024, Toronto converted his two-way contract into a standard NBA contract after averaging 24 points, 6.9 rebounds, 4.3 assists and 1.5 steals per game with [[Raptors 905]] during the [[2023–24 NBA G League season]].{{cite web|title=RAPTORS CONVERT FREEMAN-LIBERTY TO STANDARD NBA CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-convert-freeman-liberty-to-standard-nba-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 1, 2024|access-date=March 1, 2024|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240302002102/https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-convert-freeman-liberty-to-standard-nba-contract|archive-date=March 2, 2024}} On April 9, 2024, he scored a career-high 20 points in a 140–123 loss to the [[Indiana Pacers]].{{cite web|title=Haliburton's 30-point performance guides Pacers past Raptors|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/haliburtons-30-point-performance-guides-pacers-past-raptors/sn-amp/|website=SportsNet.ca|date=April 9, 2024|access-date=April 9, 2024}} Freeman-Liberty joined the Toronto Raptors for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]]. On July 22, 2024, he was waived by the Raptors.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Raptors Buy Out Sasha Vezenkov, Waive Javon Freeman-Liberty|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/07/raptors-buy-out-sasha-vezenkov-waive-javon-freeman-liberty.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=July 22, 2024|access-date=July 23, 2024}} ===Manisa Basket (2024)=== On September 18, 2024, Freeman-Liberty signed with [[Manisa Büyükşehir Belediyespor|Manisa Basket]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{cite news |title=Javon Freeman-Liberty joins Manisa |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/javon-freeman-liberty-joins-manisa/ |access-date=1 August 2025 |work=sportando |date=18 September 2024}} He appeared in one BSL game and one [[Basketball Champions League|BCL]] game before parting ways with Manisa on October 7.{{cite web|first=Johnny|last=Askounis|title=Javon Freeman-Liberty reportedly leaving Manisa, returning to the NBA|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1724368/javon-freeman-liberty-leaving-manisa-basketball-champions-league/|website=EuroHoops.net|date=October 7, 2024|access-date=October 11, 2024}} ===Return to Windy City (2024–2025)=== Freeman-Liberty signed with the [[Chicago Bulls]] on October 11, 2024, but was waived the next day.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Bulls Sign, Waive Javon Freeman-Liberty|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/javon-freeman-liberty-signs-with-bulls.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 12, 2024|access-date=October 12, 2024}} He subsequently joined the [[Windy City Bulls]] for the [[2024–25 NBA G League season]].{{cite tweet|author=Windy City Bulls|title=Welcome back Javon Freeman-Liberty! 🏀🐂 Freeman-Liberty returns to the Windy City Bulls after playing for the Toronto Raptors and their G League affiliate, the Raptors 905, in the 2023-24 season. Javon was a member of our 2022-23 squad, averaging 14.8 points in 35 games.|number=1846258148786819257|user=windycitybulls|date=October 15, 2024|access-date=October 17, 2024}} Freeman-Liberty joined the Chicago Bulls for the [[2025 NBA Summer League]]. ===Brisbane Bullets (2025–2026)=== On August 1, 2025, Freeman-Liberty signed with the [[Brisbane Bullets]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) for the [[2025–26 NBL season|2025–26 season]].{{cite news |title=Bullets add more star power for NBL26 |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/bullets-add-more-star-power-for-nbl26 |access-date=1 August 2025 |work=nbl.com.au |date=1 August 2025 |language=en}} After appearing in two games,{{cite news |title=Report: Freeman-Liberty returns to Brisbane Bullets {{!}} Basketball.com.au |url=https://www.basketball.com.au/news/javon-freeman-liberty-returns-to-brisbane-bullets-nbl |access-date=18 November 2025 |work=www.basketball.com.au |date=17 November 2025 |language=en}} he parted ways with the Bullets on October 9 in order to return home to recover from a hamstring injury and focus on his mental wellbeing.{{cite news |title=JFL Departs Brisbane Bullets |url=https://www.brisbanebullets.com.au/news/jfl-departs-brisbane-bullets |access-date=9 October 2025 |work=Brisbane Bullets {{!}} Official NBL Website |date=9 October 2025}} On November 18, the Bullets announced that Freeman-Liberty would returned to Brisbane and re-join the team for the rest of the season.{{cite news |title=JFL Returns to the Bullets |url=https://www.brisbanebullets.com.au/news/jfl-returns-to-the-bullets |access-date=18 November 2025 |work=Brisbane Bullets {{!}} Official NBL Website |date=18 November 2025}} He made his return appearance on December 11.{{cite news |title=Bullets star cleared for return |url=https://www.nbl.com.au/news/bullets-star-javon-freeman-liberty-cleared-for-return |access-date=11 December 2025 |work=nbl.com.au |date=9 December 2025 |language=en}} On January 8, 2026, he was ruled out for at least four weeks with a hamstring injury.{{cite news |title=Bullets stars set for long stint on sidelines |url=https://www.nbl.com.au/news/brisbane-bullets-stars-set-for-long-stint-on-sidelines |access-date=8 January 2026 |work=nbl.com.au |date=8 January 2026 |language=en}} He was ruled out for the rest of the season on February 5. He made nine appearances for the Bullets.{{cite news |title=Star Bullet ruled out for season |url=https://www.nbl.com.au/news/star-bullet-javon-freeman-liberty-ruled-out-for-season |access-date=5 February 2026 |work=nbl.com.au |date=5 February 2026 |language=en}} ===Long Island Nets (2026)=== On March 16, 2026, Freeman-Liberty was acquired off waivers by the [[Long Island Nets]] of the NBA G League.{{cite web |title=LONG ISLAND NETS ACQUIRE JAVON FREEMAN-LIBERTY |url=https://longisland.gleague.nba.com/news/long-island-nets-acquire-javon-freeman-liberty |website=Long Island Nets |access-date=March 29, 2026 |date=March 16, 2026}} === Montreal Alliance (2026) === On May 14, 2026, Freeman-Liberty signed with the [[Montreal Alliance]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]] (CEBL).{{Cite web |date=May 14, 2026 |title=THE MONTREAL ALLIANCE SIGN FORMER TORONTO RAPTORS GUARD JAVON FREEMAN-LIBERTY |url=https://www.alliancemontreal.ca/the-montreal-alliance-sign-former-toronto-raptors-guard-javon-freeman-liberty}} ===Bursaspor Basketbol (2026–present)=== On August 16, 2026, he signed with
